title: Komkhulu, Konkwana near Willowvale (town only, approx.): headman, 44, and his mother, 70, shot dead, 13 Oct
summary: Police say two armed men stormed a homestead in Komkhulu locality, Konkwana administrative area, near Willowvale, at about 18:45 on Tuesday 13 October, held five people at gunpoint and demanded cash and a firearm, then s...
story: Police say two armed men stormed a homestead in Komkhulu locality, Konkwana administrative area, near Willowvale, at about 18:45 on Tuesday 13 October, held five people at gunpoint and demanded cash and a firearm, then shot dead the headman, 44, and his mother, 70. His wife and two others were unhurt. The Provincial Serious and Violent Crime Investigation unit is on the case; no arrests reported. The Dispatch calls it the second killing of a traditional leader in Willowvale in about a month; no source links the two. The victims were not named.
location_note: Komkhulu locality, Konkwana administrative area, near Willowvale (SAPS). Neither place is in OpenStreetMap, and GeoNames' places named Komkhulu are in other municipalities. The pin is Willowvale town, the same point as the Willowvale Extension 1 pin; the homestead may be well outside town.

provenance.note: Six outlets, all repeating the police statement. The Dispatch adds background on an earlier traditional-leader killing, not on this one, and gives that earlier killing two different years.

sources.quote: They opened fire, fatally wounding the 44-year-old headman and his 70-year-old mother, before fleeing the scene.
